message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current USD‑GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent market data (mid‑2024), the rate is roughly:

| Currency | Approximate Rate |
|----------|------------------|
| 1 USD    | 0.77 GBP         |

Using that rate:

\[
\$20 \times 0.77 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.40
\]

So, **$20 is about £15.40**.  

> **Note:** Exchange rates change constantly due to market conditions. For an exact, up‑to‑date conversion, check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion tool.
